Next collections: Schedule tab: small uppercase section label above the list of the next six collection dates.
Recycling week: Schedule tab, Next collections row: muted line under the bin list when that date includes the fortnightly recycling collection.
No recycling: Schedule tab, Next collections row: muted line under the bin list when that date is the off week of a fortnightly recycling schedule.
%@ is %@: collections that week may chan: Schedule tab, holiday line for councils without a verified holiday rule. First %@ is the public holiday's name, second is its date (e.g. 'Monday 28 December').
The next fortnight: Schedule tab: small uppercase label at the top, above the scrolling strip of the next fourteen days.
